verdict.rationale: 2FAS describes 2FAS Auth as a 'Free, Open-source 2FA Authenticator App' (probe-rt-1, probe-1), and its docs point users to a GitHub repository to inspect and review the browser extension code (docs-6, docs-13, docs-7). Code handling seeds is therefore publicly inspectable, though 2FAS Pass is only described as 'source-available' (docs-21). missing for 10: an explicit mobile-app repository link or license details, independent evidence of community review or audits, and true open-source (not just source-available) status for 2FAS Pass.
